info.description: Returns summary information about the machines in the workspace.

requests.description: Retrieves the specified client group
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{workspaceName}/features/serviceMap/clientGroups/{clientGroupName}
requests.note: Replace {{SERVICE_MAP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a collection of machines matching the specified conditions.  The returned collection represents either machines that are active/live during the specified interval  of time (`live=true` and `startTime`/`endTime` are specified) or that are known to have existed at or  some time prior to the specified point in time (`live=false` and `timestamp` is specified).
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{workspaceName}/features/serviceMap/machines
requests.note: Replace {{SERVICE_MAP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
